from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from llm_router import LLMRouter, Model, Provider, ProviderLimits, RouterProfile

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@pytest.mark.asyncio
@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_ASYNC_PROVIDER_EXECUTION[revision==1]")
async def test_async_fallback_success_remembers_blocked_route(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    env_nvidia = "NVIDIA_API_KEY"
    env_groq = "GROQ_API_KEY"
    value = "mock-provider-auth-12345"
    monkeypatch.setenv(env_nvidia, value)
    monkeypatch.setenv(env_groq, value)

    limits = ProviderLimits(
        rps=0.1,
        rpm=10.0,
        cooldown_seconds=60.0,
        cooldown_after_failures=1,
    )
    profile_first = RouterProfile(
        model=Model.DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH,
        provider=Provider.NVIDIA,
        default_limits=limits,
    )
    profile_second = RouterProfile(
        model=Model.LLAMA_8B,
        provider=Provider.GROQ,
    )
    profiles = [profile_first, profile_second]

    sync_router = LLMRouter(
        profiles,
        round_robin_start=False,
        shuffle_fallbacks=False,
    )
    sync_router.query("prompt 1")
    sync_router.query("prompt 2")
    sync_response = sync_router.query("prompt 3")

    async_router = LLMRouter(
        profiles,
        round_robin_start=False,
        shuffle_fallbacks=False,
    )
    await async_router.aquery("prompt 1")
    await async_router.aquery("prompt 2")
    async_response = await async_router.aquery("prompt 3")

    sync_order = [attempt.route_index for attempt in sync_response.routing_trace]
    async_order = [attempt.route_index for attempt in async_response.routing_trace]
    assert async_order == sync_order
    assert next(iter(async_order)) == 1
